description: Shop jigs (acrylic sheet corner marking guide): black PLA on smooth PEI.
changelog: 2026-10-16  created for the acrylic corner drill guide: printed top-face down on smooth PEI (lips up), 4 walls so the 1/8 in guide hole is ringed in solid plastic

2026-10-16  model: now a marking guide (2.5 mm awl/pen hole with a centring cone); holes are drilled afterwards with a step bit or a drill press, so nothing spinning touches the PLA
